DatePicker，值为 'YYYY-MM-DD'；lt / gt 显示为早于: DatePicker, value 'YYYY-MM-DD'; lt / gt read as before / after
allowGroups={false} 去掉条件组；字段的 operators: allowGroups={false} drops condition groups; a field's operators limits the operators offered; disabled shows the conditions without letting anyone change them.
between 为 [最小, 最大]，in / not_in 为数组，为空 /: between: [min, max]; in / not_in: an array; is empty / is not empty: null; otherwise a single value
select 字段的选项；label 为中文原文: Choices of a select field; label is Chinese source text
下拉框里的名称（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Name in the dropdown (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
下拉选择；in / not_in 为多选，值保持选项原本的类型: A dropdown; in / not_in pick several; values keep the option's own type
任何修改后调用，传入新的完整值: Called after every change with the new complete value
写进条件的字段名；K 通常是字段名的联合类型: The field name written into the condition; K is usually a union of field names
决定可选的操作符和值的输入方式: Decides the operators offered and how the value is entered
只提供这些操作符（该类型操作符的子集，按给定顺序）: Offers only these operators (a subset of the type's, in this order)
只读：显示条件但不能修改: Read-only: shows the conditions but they can't be changed
可以作为条件的字段，见下方 ConditionField；新条件默认用第一个字段: The fields conditions can test, see ConditionField below; a new condition starts with the first field
在表单中保存查询: Saving a query in a form
当前条件（受控），纯 JSON，可以直接保存或提交: The current conditions (controlled): plain JSON, ready to save or submit
把值变成行的判断函数，在前端过滤已加载的数据；没填完的条件跳过。服务端数据则把值: Turn the value into a row predicate to filter data already loaded in the browser; unfinished conditions are skipped. For server data, send the value with the list request instead.
按字段类型：类型列是可选的操作符（第一个是新条件的默认值），默认值列是新条件的初: By field type: the Type column lists the operators offered (the first is the default for a new condition), the Default column the value a new condition starts with.
数字输入框；between 为两个输入框: A number input; two inputs for between
显示「新增条件组」；false 时只有一层条件: Shows "Add group"; with false there is a single level of conditions
条件组：{ logic, items }，只有一层嵌套: Condition groups: { logic, items }, nested one level only
用 FormCustom 接进 react-hook-form：保存过的值直接作: Wired into react-hook-form with FormCustom: a saved value goes straight into the default values, and a rule requires at least one condition.
给字段列表标注 ConditionField<K>[]，K 是字段名的联合类型；: Annotate the field list as ConditionField<K>[], with K a union of field names; the field type decides the operators and the value input. "Current value" shows what onChange passes out.
这一层的条件和条件组怎样组合：满足全部或满足任一: How this level's conditions and groups combine: match all or match any
这一层的条件：{ field, operator, value }: This level's conditions: { field, operator, value }
高级筛选和保存的查询：每个条件由字段、操作符和值组成，同一层用「满足全部」(AN: For advanced filters and saved queries: each condition is a field, an operator and a value; a level combines them with "Match all" (AND) or "Match any" (OR), and condition groups nest one level deeper. The component is controlled and only edits the value: the value is plain JSON, and saving it, turning it into API parameters or filtering data in the browser is up to the page. It doesn't nest deeper than one level or compare two fields with each other.
